page: Microsoft Azure D128nlds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dnldv6 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, this server features 128 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a low memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance includes 7559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity local disk space. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. The hardware profile is optimized for network throughput and local storage access, though it lacks dedicated GPU hardware.

The primary tradeoff of the D128nlds_v6 is its low memory density relative to its massive compute capacity. This makes it less suitable for memory-intensive in-memory databases, but highly efficient for compute-heavy workloads that require high network throughput and substantial local NVMe storage. Appropriate workloads include network-bound distributed systems, large-scale web serving, and data processing tasks that do not require high memory-per-core ratios.
